$comment: How-to-obtain notes, written for this project in our own words from each item's KHWiki page (the infobox "get" or shop price for this game). wiki is the KHWiki page title. Items without "how" show only the link.

kb.crabclaw.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Atlantica.

kb.divine-rose.how: Talk to Belle in the Hollow Bastion library.

kb.fairy-harp.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Neverland.

kb.jungle-king.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Deep Jungle.

kb.kingdom-key.how: Received when you talk to Riku after the Heartless attack Destiny Islands.

kb.lady-luck.how: From the White Trinity mark in Wonderland's Lotus Forest.

kb.lionheart.how: Beat Leon and Cloud in the Hades Cup.

kb.metal-chocobo.how: Beat Cloud in the Hercules Cup.

kb.oathkeeper.how: Talk to Kairi in the Secret Waterway after rescuing her.

kb.olympia.how: Chest in the Coliseum lobby, after you clear the Phil, Pegasus and Hercules Cups.

kb.pumpkinhead.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Halloween Town.

kb.spellbinder.how: Talk to Merlin once you've learned all seven first-level spells.

kb.three-wishes.how: Reward for sealing the Keyhole in Agrabah.

lv.aero.how: Each of these gives Aero or an upgrade (Aerora, Aeroga): defeating the Opposite Armor in Traverse Town, the Yellow Trinity mark in the Ship's hold, and rescuing all 99 puppies.

lv.blizzard.how: Each of these gives Blizzard or an upgrade (Blizzara, Blizzaga): talking to the Cheshire Cat after finding the Claw Marks or defeating the Trickmaster, defeating Jafar, and defeating the Behemoth in the Hades Cup.

lv.cure.how: Each of these gives Cure or an upgrade (Cura, Curaga): defeating Clayton and the Stealth Sneak, rescuing Tinker Bell from Captain Hook, and talking to Aerith in the library three times after defeating the Behemoth.

lv.fire.how: Each of these gives Fire or an upgrade (Fira, Firaga): defeating the Guard Armor in Traverse Town, defeating Genie Jafar, and talking to the Princesses of Heart after sealing the Final Keyhole.

lv.gravity.how: Each of these gives Gravity or an upgrade (Gravira, Graviga): completing the Phil Cup, clearing Oogie's Manor, and defeating Hades in the Hades Cup.

lv.stop.how: Each of these gives Stop or an upgrade (Stopra, Stopga): defeating the Parasite Cage the second time, completing Pooh's Swing, and defeating the Phantom.

lv.thunder.how: Each of these gives Thunder or an upgrade (Thundara, Thundaga): completing Phil's training, defeating the giant Ursula, and defeating Cerberus in the Hades Cup.

sh.dream-shield.how: Chosen in the Dive to the Heart at the start of the game.

sh.genji-shield.how: Beat Yuffie in the Hades Cup.

sh.save-the-king.how: Clear the Hades Cup time trial.

sm.bambi.how: Summon Gem from completing Pooh's Hunny Hunt; take it to the Fairy Godmother.

sm.dumbo.how: Summon Gem in a chest in Monstro's Mouth; take it to the Fairy Godmother.

sm.genie.how: Unlocked after sealing the Keyhole in Agrabah.

sm.mushu.how: Summon Gem from defeating Dragon Maleficent; take it to the Fairy Godmother.

sm.simba.how: Leon gives Sora a Summon Gem at the Secret Waterway; the Fairy Godmother awakens it.

sm.tinker.how: Unlocked after sealing the Keyhole in Neverland.

st.dream-rod.how: Chosen in the Dive to the Heart at the start of the game.

st.lord-fortune.how: Talk to the Fairy Godmother once you have every summon.

st.violetta.how: From the White Trinity mark at the Coliseum Gates.
